title: Axel Oxenstierna → Queen Christina (the regency), Frankfurt am Main: four cipher passages whose interlinear decipherment is largely washed out by damp
correspondents: Axel Oxenstierna → Queen Christina / the Swedish regency council
shelfmark: Riksarkivet, Skrivelser till konungen, Kristinas tid, SE/RA/1133/1133.08/12 (Axel Oxenstierna 20/6-6/12 1634; damp-damaged), fol. 713-714
folio_note: image series R0001377, images 129 (recto, fol. 713: passages of 3 and 2 lines) and 130 (verso: passages of 5 and 3 lines); numeric nomenclator, 2-4 digit groups with doubled letters, digits not struck through; faint interlinear writing in a weaker ink survives above the lower passage of 129 and in the upper passage of 130, nothing legible above the other two
status: Viewed 11 Nov 2026 at full resolution (4966 px). Deciphered by the chancery at the time, but the gloss is mostly lost to damp; the same code is fully glossed on some 60 other leaves of volumes 7-13 (list in README). The register of Handlingar rörande Skandinaviens historia (del 41) lists this letter as printed in del 30, p. 91; del 30 was not found on archive.org and was not opened, so whether the cipher passages are printed in clear is not checked. Not on DECODE under this shelfmark (searches below). Lead only, no vetting block.
why: The chancellor's report on the Frankfurt convention's deliberations on Swedish satisfaction; the only cipher in the ten volumes whose decipherment is not fully legible on the leaf.
score_note: Scored from the scan during the 11 Nov 2026 Riksarkivet paging sweep (research/sweep_2026-11-11_riksarkivet_paging/); viewed
verify: Open Handlingar rörande Skandinaviens historia del 30 (1849), p. 91 ff., and AOSB I:12 (letters of 1634) at 30 July 1634: if the passages are printed in clear this is closed as read. Otherwise rebuild the key from the glossed leaves (1133.08/12 images 125, 308-325; 1133.08/13 images 29-39) and read the four passages.
prior_art: Probably printed: HSH register (archive.org handlingarrrand03scangoog, del 41) has 'Axel Oxenstiernas bref t. K. M:t ang. conventets deliberationer om svenska kronans satisfaction. Dat. Frankf. a. M. 30 Juli 1634 ... 30: 91'; del 30 and AOSB I:12 not opened. DECODE RecordsList searches '1133.08', 'Skrivelser', 'konungen': 0 records; 'Oxenstierna': 20 records, none from this series. Tomokiyo and Lasry not searched.
